what: What the removed `emir layout` reported on this GDS (make_layouts.py's sink.gds) at the operating point of tb_op.cir.in: its network built from the layout's rectangles on the process file's layers (li1 and up; no contacts below li1, no diffusion), the devices extracted by magic and simulated by Xyce on ideal rails with a 0 V probe on every terminal. Run with the last version of EMIR that had the command, on 2026-10-04, with pdks/sky130.yaml at 90 C; its golden digest, which Xyce 7.10 and ngspice 45 reproduced. A record, not a check: the command is gone.
